---
name: speckit-specify
description: Turn a product or feature description into a testable specification.
---

Read the constitution and repository guidance first. Use the user request as the source of truth, ask only essential clarifying questions, and create `specs/<next-number>-<slug>/spec.md` from `.specify/templates/spec-template.md`. Define prioritized independently testable user stories, acceptance scenarios, edge cases, requirements, measurable success criteria, and assumptions. Do not choose implementation technology here.
